advancement.oborokage.moon.title: Sheathed Before Moonset
advancement.oborokage.moon.description: Slay at least three non-player creatures in one fully charged iaido, taking no damage until recovery ends.
tooltip.oborokage.charge: Hold use for 2 seconds; release to draw
tooltip.oborokage.flavor: Moonlight on the edge. Shadow before sound.
tooltip.oborokage.wakizashi: Offhand partner for any Oborokage blade; drawn alone it has its own ultimate
tooltip.oborokage.controls: Attack to alternate; rebind guard, step and ultimate in Controls.
advancement.oborokage.first_moon.title: Oborokage Chronicle: First Moonrise
advancement.oborokage.twin_moons.title: Two Moons, One Path
advancement.oborokage.twin_moons.descrip: Hold the tachi and wakizashi together for a second.
advancement.oborokage.alternating_finish: Land both hands of a combo and finish a hostile with its cross-cut.
advancement.oborokage.borrowed_blade.tit: A Blade Borrowed, a Moon Returned
advancement.oborokage.borrowed_blade.des: Perfect-guard and defeat that attacker with the counter.
advancement.oborokage.decisive_step.desc: Complete a shadow step and promptly land an offhand strike.
advancement.oborokage.three_breaths.desc: Perfect-guard three distinct attacks within twenty seconds, unharmed.
advancement.oborokage.break_and_cut.desc: Break posture and cross-cut within the opening.
advancement.oborokage.twin_moon_ultimate: Defeat a hostile with the dual ultimate finishing cut.
advancement.oborokage.flawless_night.des: Defeat five hostiles with at least three dual actions in sixty seconds; land both hands and take no damage.
tooltip.oborokage.storm: 20 ticks to full charge: a swift close assault.
tooltip.oborokage.terrain: Sneak and charge: cut blocks or connected logs. More charge cuts more.
tooltip.oborokage.frost: 40 ticks to full charge: a radial cut that slows nearby foes.
tooltip.oborokage.void: 40 ticks to full charge: a wall-blocked energy line up to 28 blocks.
ui.oborokage.guide: Attack for the dual chain; hold use to charge a technique; sneak-charge to cut terrain. %s guard · %s step · %s ultimate (at 100 intent, any blade unleashes its own).
ui.oborokage.key_conflict: Oborokage key conflict: %s and %s share a key. Rebind in Controls.
Cut at least sixteen logs with one harvesting action.
advancement.oborokage.frost_truce.title: Frostbound Truce
advancement.oborokage.frost_truce.descri: Slow three hostiles with one Frostmoon technique.
advancement.oborokage.far_bank.title: Across the Far Bank
advancement.oborokage.far_bank.descripti: Land a Voidstring technique on a hostile at least sixteen blocks away.
advancement.oborokage.five_paths.title: Five Blades, One Path
advancement.oborokage.five_paths.descrip: Carry all five Oborokage blades at once.
advancement.oborokage.afterimage.title: Afterimage
advancement.oborokage.afterimage.descrip: Slip an attack in the opening instant of a Shadow Step.
advancement.oborokage.thunder_chain.desc: With Raikiri as the main blade, chain a cross cut's lightning into two more enemies.
tooltip.oborokage.art.tachi: Dual finisher · Eclipse: the cross cut breaks posture faster
tooltip.oborokage.art.storm: Dual finisher · Thunder Chain; a full-charge kill recalls the assault almost at once
tooltip.oborokage.art.frost: Dual finisher · Rime: three stacks freeze; full charge rings again after half a second
tooltip.oborokage.art.void: Dual finisher · Void Edge; full charge leaves a mark that dual hits detonate
tooltip.oborokage.ult.tachi: Ultimate · Twin Moons: a moon rises, two moons cross, the heavens are cut (1000 · execution)
tooltip.oborokage.ult.moon: Ultimate · Hundred Flowers: eight whirling cuts, the ninth blooms
tooltip.oborokage.ult.storm: Ultimate · Ten Thousand Thunders: blink through six foes, thunder falls at the end
tooltip.oborokage.ult.frost: Ultimate · Mirror Moon: freeze a 12-block lake, then shatter it
tooltip.oborokage.ult.void: Ultimate · Severing the Realms: draw the sky's string and cut 48 blocks of world, through walls
advancement.oborokage.all_ultimates.desc: Unleash the ultimate of all five blades.
advancement.oborokage.shake_heavens.desc: Fell a foe with at least 150 health using an ultimate.
tooltip.oborokage.solo.tachi: Alone · three-cut chain; finisher "Waning Moon": the blade's shadow cuts again
tooltip.oborokage.solo.moon: Alone · three-cut chain; finisher "Falling Petals": a full turn that quickens the feet
tooltip.oborokage.solo.storm: Alone · three-cut chain; finisher "Thunderflash": lightning leaps to enemies beyond reach
tooltip.oborokage.solo.frost: Alone · three-cut chain; every cut frosts, finisher "Frost Bloom" rings out a chill
tooltip.oborokage.solo.void: Alone · three-cut chain; finisher "Void Edge": sword-qi pierces the rank behind
